name: codex-commit-message
description: Generate a commit message from staged Git changes with Codex.

codexCommitMessage.commandPath.description: Optional path to the Codex CLI executable. Leave empty to use the Codex bundled with ChatGPT.app, then PATH.

codexCommitMessage.language.description: Language for the generated commit subject.

codexCommitMessage.conventional.description: Ask Codex to use the Conventional Commits format.

codexCommitMessage.model.description: Codex model to use. The default Astra model is fast for this short task.

codexCommitMessage.reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort passed to Codex. Low is recommended for short commit messages.

codexCommitMessage.prompt.default: Describe the staged changes accurately and choose the most useful commit subject for a reviewer.
codexCommitMessage.prompt.description: Additional instructions for the commit-message generator. The staged-only and one-line output rules are always enforced.
